### Caesars Entertainment Atlantic City Resorts Raise More Than $180K for Breast Cancer Awareness Through Men Wear Pink Campaign


11/04/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) DOCX](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/04/202611_ACM_Men-Wear-Pink-Campaign-Release.docx)


***The resorts were the top three fundraising teams in the Greater Philadelphia area, with Tropicana Atlantic City leading the charge as No. 1 regional team and earning national recognition as No. 7 in the country*** ******


**For hi-res photos, click**[HERE](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/zrtffeyq4k2w9c46gsima/AFkpkvhKg0k-QJ29PMHlG6c?dl=0&e=1&rlkey=e6a862n20pmznb1xnqplb6wmu&st=256vtyki)


**ATLANTIC CITY, N.J. – Nov. 4, 2026 –** Caesars Entertainment’s Atlantic City resorts, Caesars, Harrah’s Resort and Tropicana, united in the fight against breast cancer, **raising $180,908** through the American Cancer Society’s Men Wear Pink campaign.


The trio of resorts ranked as the **top three fundraising teams in the Greater Philadelphia area** . Together, they exceeded their 2025 fundraising total by more than $50,000, a testament to the dedication and leadership of their Men Wear Pink ambassadors. Efforts were spearheaded by[Keith Purnell](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/secure.acsevents.org/site/STR/?fr_id=112630&pg=personal&px=61335304__;!!A2VBZwsE!ySizqGfu0Tcy4jVKYZZHdCcIzckbe9xV_r28Bag59Gq7as1kCAPpGWz8u-C9oDPm2DWJFSAvdVN4PBlyK7eOv0sEEdzY$) , senior director of hotel operations, and[Christian Golder](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/secure.acsevents.org/site/STR/?fr_id=112630&pg=personal&px=61335304__;!!A2VBZwsE!ySizqGfu0Tcy4jVKYZZHdCcIzckbe9xV_r28Bag59Gq7as1kCAPpGWz8u-C9oDPm2DWJFSAvdVN4PBlyK7eOv0sEEdzY$) , vice president of security, both of Caesars Atlantic City;[Jim Marota](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/secure.acsevents.org/site/STR/?fr_id=112630&pg=personal&px=61286354__;!!A2VBZwsE!ySizqGfu0Tcy4jVKYZZHdCcIzckbe9xV_r28Bag59Gq7as1kCAPpGWz8u-C9oDPm2DWJFSAvdVN4PBlyK7eOv-h8-7eG$) , director of sales, Harrah’s Resort Atlantic City; and[John Happersett](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/secure.acsevents.org/site/STR/?fr_id=112630&pg=personal&px=61339252__;!!A2VBZwsE!ySizqGfu0Tcy4jVKYZZHdCcIzckbe9xV_r28Bag59Gq7as1kCAPpGWz8u-C9oDPm2DWJFSAvdVN4PBlyK7eOvztMXxYN$) , casino operations controller, and[Larry Johnson](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/secure.acsevents.org/site/STR/?fr_id=112630&pg=personal&px=61339252__;!!A2VBZwsE!ySizqGfu0Tcy4jVKYZZHdCcIzckbe9xV_r28Bag59Gq7as1kCAPpGWz8u-C9oDPm2DWJFSAvdVN4PBlyK7eOvztMXxYN$) , executive steward, both of Tropicana Atlantic City. **Tropicana’s ambassadors were not only named No. 1 in the region for fundraising, but they also earned national recognition, placing No. 7 among all Men Wear Pink ambassadors across the country.**


The ambassadors hosted a variety of fundraisers, including but not limited to, t-shirt, water ice and bake sales, prize drawings, a dunk tank event, and a Charity Golf Scramble. Their creativity helped drive Team Member engagement and community support throughout the campaign.


Men Wear Pink empowers community leaders to raise money and awareness while wearing pink throughout October. Funds support the American Cancer Society’s mission to save lives, celebrate survivors and lead the fight for a world without breast cancer.
